messages:
Marta: heads up — PR #7882 failing CI due to snapshot diffs in integration tests. saw it on main build. Marta: failing test: `integration/chat_ui_snapshot.test.ts` — diff shows timestamp rendering change. Marta: excerpt: ``` -
Mar 1, 2026
+
Mar 2, 2026
``` Cheng: hmm, looks like localization tweak? did you change timezone handling? Marta: I didn't touch time code, only message formatting for link previews. could be flaky. Sam: can we rerun CI first? `/recheck` worked last time. ci-bot: rebuild triggered by @Sam — job 7882.2 queued. Alex: if it's nondeterministic we should avoid updating snapshots. but if it's intended behavior, we need a snapshot PR and 2 approvals from frontend. Marta: CC @frontend for approvals — @Alex can you review once CI passes? hoping to merge today. Cheng: I can take a quick look; if it's just date format change then update snapshots and add small test asserting format. Sam: rerun passed 10 minutes later — ci-bot: job 7882.2 ✅ all integration tests passed except `visual/snapshots`. Marta: pushing a snapshot update in the same branch now (`git commit -m "update snapshots: chat timestamp"`). Alex: quick check: include note in PR description why snapshots updated, assign to me and @Cheng. I can approve after verifying. release-bot: Reminder: merging with snapshot updates requires 2 reviewers and green e2e in dedicated runners. Marta: thanks — PTAL @Alex @Cheng. I'll hold merge until approvals. Cheng: reviewing now, should be quick :thumbsup: Alex: Approved. small change, ok to merge after one more run. Marta: merging now, will watch post-merge CI. ci-bot: merge queued. build 7882.3 started. Marta: thanks everyone.
